profile.name: Dhawal Shukla
profile.education_short: B.Tech, Electronics & Communication Engineering • JIIT Noida (2023–2027)
profile.summary: Backend engineer building secure backend systems, cloud-native applications and developer tooling. Experienced with Node.js, Python, Go, REST APIs, WebSockets, JWT/OAuth 2.0, Docker, MongoDB, PostgreSQL and AI integrations. Passionate about backend infrastructure, system design and continuously advancing towards Network Security engineering.

resume.summary: Backend engineer specialising in Node.js, Python and Go ecosystems with experience shipping production platforms: real-time messaging, payment processing, polyglot database architectures and AI-driven data pipelines. Skilled in secure backend architecture using JWT, OAuth 2.0, RBAC, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Docker and self-hosted Linux/cloud infrastructure.

experience.description: Engineered capecomorinschool.com using Next.js and Flask, integrating Vritukul (a FastAPI service with a Gemini multimodal pipeline), reducing student and admission record lookup time from hours to 30 seconds using RapidFuzz fuzzy name matching. Implemented Firebase JWT authentication and RBAC across admin panels used by 10+ school staff, with data storage across Turso, Neon PostgreSQL and Cloudinary.

Collaborated with a 3-engineer backend team to containerize services with Docker and configure Clerk authentication with RBAC for employees, users and a super admin role. Designed and implemented REST APIs using Node.js and Express.js, backed by MongoDB.

projects.name: thewittyswan Terminal
projects.description: Self-hosted, browser-based developer terminal built with a Go backend and xterm.js frontend, running on a GCP e2-micro VM behind a Caddy reverse proxy under systemd. Includes a live network security lab (TLS inspection, DNS diagnostics, HTTP security header auditing, port reachability checks, and OSV.dev-backed dependency vulnerability lookups), all guarded against SSRF via strict host/IP validation on every outbound check.

projects.name: VartaLang
projects.description: Language Exchange to Career Platform featuring real-time messaging, Google OAuth, JWT authentication, room-based Socket.io communication, CRON automation and multilingual matching.

projects.name: Cosmo India Prakashan

This was my first production backend project and marked the beginning of my backend engineering journey in 2025.
